name: Slack — Send Message
author: hearth-team
description: Post a message to Slack via chat.postMessage. Bring your own SLACK_BOT_TOKEN (a bot token with the chat:write scope). Args: text (required — the message body, Slack markdown/mrkdwn ok), channel (optional — channel id like C0123ABCD or a #channel name; falls back to your configured default channel). The bot must be a member of the target channel. Returns the posted message timestamp + channel.

vault_inputs.label: Slack bot token
vault_inputs.help: Create a Slack app at https://api.slack.com/apps → OAuth & Permissions → add the 'chat:write' bot scope → Install to Workspace → copy the 'Bot User OAuth Token' (starts with xoxb-). Invite the bot to any channel it should post in.

vault_inputs.label: Default channel
vault_inputs.help: Used when a message doesn't name a channel. A channel id (C0123ABCD) is most reliable; a #channel name also works.
